integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the definition of the P-angle constant. The finite facet-functional table and the attaining pair were replayed from the bundled verifier. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result evaluates the P-angle constant only for the affine-regular hexagonal plane. It does not classify arbitrary hexagonal norms or establish inheritance under subspaces or quotients. The defining preprint has an earlier standing dimension convention, although Definition 3.1 is stated for a Banach space and its following remark explicitly treats a two-dimensional Euclidean plane; the present calculation uses the displayed definition directly.
title: Exact P-angle constant of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
